preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.
Number of cities in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 10**6 for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Initial flag colors are between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= 10**6 for d_i in d)
preconditions.description: Desired flag colors are between 1 and 1,000,000.
There are exactly n-1 roads in Treeland.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_j <= n and 1 <= y_j <= n for x_j, y_j in edges)

postconditions.expression: all(c_i == d_i for c_i, d_i in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: If initial and desired colors match, the route length is 0.

postconditions.expression: any(c_i != d_i for c_i, d_i in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: If initial and desired colors do not match, determine if a valid route exists.
The route length k matches the number of cities in the route.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n for u_i in route)
postconditions.description: All cities in the route are valid.

postconditions.expression: all((route[i], route[i+1]) in edges or (route[i+1], route[i]) in edges for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: Consecutive cities in the route are directly connected by a road.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i == d_i for c_i, d_i in zip(c, d))
postconditions.description: After the route, the flag colors match the desired colors.
